slides.h: The sofa: splurge on the //frame//, skip the trend colour.
slides.dek: The one purchase that should outlive three flats.

body: Kiln-dried hardwood frame, proper suspension, feather-wrapped foam in the cushions.
You are paying for what you cannot see. It is the difference between a sofa at year ten and landfill at year three.
A bold trend shade looks current for about eighteen months, and reupholstering costs more than the fabric did.
Buy the quiet base. Rent the trend through cushions and a throw.
Lift one end: a good frame feels heavier than it looks. Check for joined corners, not staples and glue.
Sit for five full minutes. The first thirty seconds of any sofa are comfortable.

slides.h: Save this before the showroom trip.
